query: INSERT INTO forge_kv (key, value, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, CASE WHEN $3::double precision IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() + make_interval(secs => $3) END) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at WHERE forge_kv.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND forge_kv.expires_at <= now() RETURNING key
